scope: Anonymous synthetic numerical reference; independent of the MARSE Python engine

diffusion_convergence.endpoint: relative L2 against exact Neumann cosine solution
diffusion_convergence.acceptance: decreasing error at each refinement; finest error < 0.003

reaction_transport_grid.endpoint: relative total biomass error against numerical reference
reaction_transport_grid.acceptance: decreasing error; finest < 0.005; reference is not biological truth

calibration.plan: Obtain host/site/compartment measurements with units and sampling metadata; fit only identifiable terms; group related observations to prevent leakage

evaluation.plan: Freeze model, parameters, endpoints, tolerances and exclusions before independent held-out observations; existing selected panels and benchmark labels are not unseen validation
